Akses bijih segar Phase 8 meningkat menj: Phase 8 fresh-ore access rose to 66 juta tonnes from 6 juta tonnes; higher grades and milled volume lifted concentrate production 81% yoy.
Presentasi H1 menyebut smelter dan PMR l: The H1 presentation states that the smelter and PMR passed their Performance Guarantee Tests; the June smelter rate was 93%, July-August production rates improved/stabilized, and the H2 note cites new performance records in July-August. Smelter dan PMR sudah berproduksi pada 1: The smelter and PMR were already producing in 1H26: 48.756 tonnes of copper cathode and 122.131 oz of refined gold. PAC in July is a project-acceptance milestone, not the start of operations.

Per 24 September 2026, Q2 actual dapat d: As of 24 September 2026, Q2 actuals can be derived as H1 less Q1 down to the US$ thousand level for the income statement and cash flow. H2 concentrate export sales volume is unknown: the temporary permit expired on 30 April; Detik on 6 May quoted an NTB official saying AMNT had applied for a six-month extension, but on 7 May an AMMAN spokesperson stated directly that it had not applied; the head of the NTB ESDM office said on 6 June that AMNT did not yet plan to apply. The official H1 presentation states that January-April direct sales used the permit then available. The sources reviewed hold no application document, replacement permit, domestic sales channel or official status after June. Zero export sales in the base product bridge is therefore only a conservative sensitivity branch, not an actual fact or guidance; the 120.079 dmt case is likewise conditional on a permit/channel and contracts. AMMAN disclosed a Glencore contract for cathode deliveries until at least December 2027 and a prepayment balance of US$388m in June 2026, but the delivery volumes and pricing formula are not published. Remaining FY26 output under guidance: 553 kdmt of concentrate, 274 Mlbs of Cu in concentrate, 429 koz of gold in concentrate, 81 kt of cathode and 228 koz of refined gold. For refined metals, Q2 sell-through is derived from Q2 production/sales and applied as the H2 assumption; H1 realized prices serve as a proxy, not a forward price. Top-down H2 revenue of US$2.975bn still has a gap of about US$974m to the product bridge without concentrate sales. The H1 concentrate production-sales difference of 227.228 dmt has not been reconciled across smelter feed, stockpile and sales timing. Q2 actuals now give finance costs of US$129m and tax of US$100m, but there is no reconciled H2 schedule of interest, tax or debt repayment; the planned Q3 debt repayment of US$350m is still an outlook. The H2 EBITDA margin of 55%, net margin of 24,5% and capex of 2,0x H1 remain Analyst Assumptions. Accrued capital expenditure of US$100m in June is not the remaining project budget; the capex schedule, working capital and H2/LoM FCFF are not yet bridged.
